closing.summary: Big strengths are omega 3, easy staple to build meals around, and better category fit than white rice, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin B12, low calcium, and low protein quality. It is good for energy, practical meals, and digestion because the carb section gives it a clear fuel role, the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, and fibre supports digestion and steadier meals.
